subject: English
passage: Some residents of a small coastal town in Maine recently started a tool-lending library at their community center. The residents agreed to take turns staffing the library and maintaining the tools. Students at a nearby high school surveyed some of the volunteers as part of a project to understand the impact of the new library. The students concluded that the library benefited the town overall by fostering connections and relationships between the volunteers and other residents of the town who weren't volunteering at the library.
prompt: Which quotation from a survey respondent would best illustrate the students' conclusion?

choices.A: "One of our earliest tasks was sorting through all the donated tools and figuring out which ones were safe to lend out. Some needed repairs before we could add them to the collection."
choices.B: "A lot of people in town stop by when they need a tool, and we often end up chatting about their projects. Several borrowers have come back later to share how their repairs turned out, and a few have even offered tips we've passed along to other borrowers."
choices.C: "I really enjoy my shifts at the library, especially on quiet afternoons when I can organize the shelves and make sure everything is in its proper place."
choices.D: "The best part for me is the sense of accomplishment I feel when I drive past the community center. Knowing I helped build something useful for the town makes me proud."

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. This quotation describes volunteers interacting with non-volunteer residents who come to borrow tools, chatting about their projects and exchanging tips — direct evidence of the connections and relationships the students concluded the library was fostering.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. This respondent describes the practical work of sorting and repairing donated tools, which has nothing to do with the conclusion about fostering connections between volunteers and other town residents.
